content.title: Global Fandom Platform - Weverse
content.text: Hello, this is BIGHIT MUSIC. We are pleased to announce BTS THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG, an event held to celebrate the release of BTS’s 5th studio album, “ARIRANG.”BTS will perform new songs from the album, including the title track, for the first time at Gwanghwamun Square, one of the most iconic spots in Korea. [Event Information]- Event Title: BTS THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG- Date and Time: 8 pm, Saturday, March 21, 2026 (KST)- Location: Gwanghwamun Square (175 Sejong-daero, Jongno-gu, Seoul)- Organized and Hosted by: BIGHIT MUSIC · HYBE- Age Limit: Admission ages 14 and above- How to View: Apply through Weverse Global or get free tickets through the ticket seller (NOL) [Weverse Global Application]- Eligibility: ARMY Membership holders who purchase eligible Weverse Global products during the application period (see the detailed announcement for detailed terms and conditions and the list of eligible products)- Announcement Date: 11 am, Tuesday, February 10, 2026 (KST)- Application Period: From 11 am, Tuesday, February 10 to 11:59 pm, Friday, February 13, 2026 (KST)▶ Click for more details [General Onsale]- Ticket Seller: NOL ticket- Ticket Price: All seats free- Announcement Date: 12 pm, Friday, February 20, 2026 (KST)- Ticket Opening: 8 pm, Monday, February 23, 2026 (KST)- Open to all; no special ticketing requirements.▶ Click for more details ※ BTS THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG will be held simultaneously online and in person.It is an outdoor event with both assigned seating and standing sections. Different operating standards may apply depending on your participation method and viewing area.BTS THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG will stream live exclusively on Netflix on March 21. Thank you.
